description: ΚΑΤΑΣΧΕΣΕΙΣ ΛΑΘΡΑΙΩΝ ΚΑΠΝΙΚΩΝ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ, ΠΛΩΤΩΝ Ή ΧΕΡΣΑΙΩΝ ΜΕΣΩΝ ΔΙΑΚΙΝΗΣΗΣ ΑΥΤΩΝ ΑΠΟ ΤΟ Λ.Σ.-ΕΛ.ΑΚΤ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Διεύθυνση Δίωξης Ναρκωτικών και Λαθρεμπορίου. Statistični podatki o zasegih pretihotapljenih tobačnih izdelkov in njihovih plavajočih ali kopenskih sredstev, ki jih izvaja grška obalna straža. Coverage: Διεύθυνση Δίωξης Ναρκωτικών και Λαθρεμπορίου. The portal shows the English title as "Kukaiņu izstrādājumu, ziedēšanas vai teritoriālu līdzekļu granulas, ko HCG pārvieto" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Διεύθυνση Δίωξης Ναρκωτικών και Λαθρεμπορίου. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Κατάσχεση, Λαθραία καπνικά προϊόντα, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2026-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
